result.reason: The redline gives Sparkling the required affiliate/M&A assignment right and subjects other assignments to consent not unreasonably withheld, but it omits the preferred position’s absolute prohibition on Garman assigning to a Sparkling competitor. It also overreaches in subsection (c): because the new exception follows the entire list, it appears to permit transfer, lease, export, or sublicensing of the Work to affiliates or successors without consent, materially changing rights unrelated to assignment. Adding suspension and repricing restrictions also goes beyond the stated no-termination requirement. The overlapping provisions create avoidable ambiguity and are not minimally or cleanly drafted.
